audit.why: Difficulty 8/10 HARD matches an immobile 1175-range mage against a 600-range resetting dash. Lane, side lane and teamfight all favour Irelia's ability to close; Lux only wins at range with a banked root.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose named cooldowns vaguely ('fifteen-second invitation') for Flawless Duet, which is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10.
audit.why: Flawless Duet's real cooldown decides the all-in window; Vanguard's Edge at 125/105/85 is the other spike gate.
audit.corrected: Cooldown field now carries Flawless Duet 16s->10s, Bladesurge 10s->6s with reset, Vanguard's Edge 125s at rank 1, and Lux Q 10s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interactions were never stated: Bladesurge refreshes on a Marked or dying target, so a predicted root feeds the reset; Defiant Dance reduces physical damage only, which does not blunt Lux at all; Vanguard's Edge creates terrain.
audit.why: Riot's text for Q says the cooldown refreshes if the target is Marked or dies to Bladesurge; W says reduced physical damage during the charge; R forms a wall.
audit.corrected: Do's/Don'ts now say Bladesurge refreshes off a dying minion, and the shield bullet points at the E-stun follow-up rather than repeating the trade line.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal timing against Bladesurge sustain was only implied.
audit.why: brief.missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal for this matchup.
audit.corrected: Itemization line keeps the anti-heal clause and now attributes the sustain to her correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Seventeen fields addressed Irelia as he/him/his.
audit.corrected: All flagged fields rewritten in she/her.

audit.whatIsWrong: lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED: the body was the tradeGood string verbatim under an unrelated title. lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED: the body was the tradeBad string verbatim under an unrelated title.
audit.why: An earlier proposal targeted these same fields but its replacement text overshot the +/-10% length rule, so apply-proposals dropped the edit and the defect survived on disk.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to the same meaning inside the length budget, grounded in real ability names and cooldowns from champ-data/_kits: dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d.

edits.before: - Irelia Flawless Duet (Stun): matchup-defining — Her stun setup — dodge it and the dive falls apart. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Prismatic Barrier has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Flawless Duet (Stun): 16s at rank 1, 10s at rank 5 — dodge it and the dive falls apart. - Bladesurge: 10s to 6s and refreshes off a kill. - Vanguard's Edge: 125s at rank 1. - Your Q is 10s: bank it for her step-up, never for poke.

notes: Level chart is all-Irelia across seven rows while the Emerald+ win rate is 50.73 over 1928 games. I could not decide from the kits alone which layer is wrong, so per the chart rule I left every row (side, rating, why, win[N]) untouched and flag it here. Content layer (whys, spikes, early/mid/late, wants) is already specific to Bladesurge resets and Vanguard's Edge — no templates found there. QA re-scope: previous edits to dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d were rejected for length drift; re-proposed within budget. Cooldowns quoted are Riot per-rank values from the kit files; no spell-shield, cleanse or minion-block behaviour is asserted anywhere, since the kits do not state it.
